verdict.rationale: The only refund evidence is Paddle's AI-agent/MCP pages, which say agents can 'process customer refunds' in natural language. The MCP server works by chaining Paddle API calls, which implies a refund-capable API operation exists, though no refund endpoint is documented in the pack. Payout reconciliation also mentions 'adjustments', but nothing describes issuing a refund. Missing for 10: documented refund/adjustment API endpoint, dashboard refund workflow, explicit support for full vs partial (line-item or amount) refunds, independent or hands-on corroboration.
